subject.title: [Feature]: Stage Control UI chat startup and transcript fast-path improvements

question: Should the project first land and remeasure the prepared-metadata fix, then treat transcript-first rendering and cross-pane startup coalescing as separately approved Control UI changes only if material latency remains?
rationale: The observed backend waste has an open narrow fix, while the remaining proposal changes the public startup composition and pane lifecycle behavior; source evidence does not establish that duplicate requests are accidental or that a separate transcript path is the intended product contract.

options.title: Land, measure, then split follow-ups
options.body: Review the open candidate first and create only measured, narrowly scoped follow-ups for confirmed duplicate work or transcript-first latency.

options.title: Adopt transcript-first as the product contract
options.body: Approve a dedicated Control UI change that commits transcript history before model controls, with explicit stale-session and reconnect ordering tests.

options.title: Keep aggregate startup semantics
options.body: Retain the current aggregate response and limit work to prepared-fact reuse and other Gateway-side responsiveness improvements.

recommendation.title: Land, measure, then split follow-ups
recommendation.body: Review the open candidate first and create only measured, narrowly scoped follow-ups for confirmed duplicate work or transcript-first latency.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked prepared-runtime tracker establishes the architectural boundary that this proposal relies on and is the strongest available routing signal.
